settings.purpose: Watertight solid mesh, ready to slice

settings.q: Will these files print on a standard FDM machine?
settings.a: Yes. This design is printable with different slicing software lilk prusa and Cura. Based on the details and scale, you will have to decide to 3d print in FDM or SLA.

settings.q: What wall thicknesses have you considered?
settings.a: We use 2mm as the smallest thickness. Since that is the lowest thickness for 3d printing in resin without deforming.

settings.q: Can I use this design for my own projects?
settings.a: Yes. These files are licensed for your personal projects — make it for yourself, your home, a study model, or a gift. Print it, cut it, machine it, remix the parametric source however you like. The license is for personal, non-commercial use, so it isn't intended for reselling finished units or the file pack itself.

settings.q: Will you support if there are any problems with files?
settings.a: After-sales support is included if you get stuck. Just contact us through the contact page and we will try to help.
We usually dont offer Refunds for Digital Files. However, if you are not satisfied with it then our designer will help you to sort things out.
